stale_contribution: visible rejection pulse, no credit/seen/status change
bad_current_tag: Protocol if no earlier fatal status; first error remains sticky; no credit for duplicate/out-of-range tags
bad_current_unique_canonical_or_marker: credit for consumed unique current contribution; error followed by drain

failure_receipt.producer: actual order.done && order.protocolError; held pending until consumer accepts
failure_receipt.safe_acceptance: Load/Drain only, hence no scalar outstanding; no competing contribution.valid
failure_receipt.wrong_identity_undrained_or_invalid_stat: visible rejectedFailure pulse; no credit/status/termination; current legitimate data not consumed by failure
failure_receipt.result: held error identity/status with invalid zero payload; not numeric publication

timeout: No internal timeout/success fallback. Parent watchdog must bound waits, isolate transaction, drain issued obligations and only then provide authentic failure or safe reset; bareerror cannot flush. Parent watchdog integration not implemented/tested by this unit.
scalar_service_integration: Consumer raw scalar port uses one outstanding request. Future tagged fabric wrapper binds transactionId64 per request; parent fabric is per-request lease, not proof of whole-tile lease or whole-block fence.
